strategies.name: Shrunk team-strength spread
strategies.hypothesis: Expanding team points scored and allowed; shrink to training league mean. Train prior weeks only.
strategies.missing: Official timestamped handicap and payout; calibrated predictive residuals; multi-season held-out settlement.

strategies.name: Shrunk scoring total
strategies.hypothesis: Same point model; compare home+away forecast to a genuine executable total. Report MAE separately from betting profit.
strategies.missing: Official timestamped total and odds; weather/injury freshness; multi-season holdout.

strategies.name: Calibrated win distribution
strategies.hypothesis: Research proposal: fit and calibrate a predictive score distribution using training-only residuals; account for ties.
strategies.missing: Verified moneyline; untouched probability-calibration holdout; no moneyline probability estimated here.

strategies.name: Cross-game value portfolio
strategies.hypothesis: Research proposal: joint scenarios with shared team/week/weather factors; price the offered parlay directly.
strategies.missing: Paired leg outcomes, official parlay payout and rules; cross-game dependence not assumed zero.

strategies.name: Side + game-total joint model
strategies.hypothesis: Research proposal: simulate joint scores; derive side and total leg outcomes from the same draw.
strategies.missing: Matched historical bet outcomes, joint calibration, official same-game payout; game-score r is not bet-leg r.

strategies.name: Opportunity-adjusted prop
strategies.hypothesis: Research proposal: project opportunity then per-opportunity production; propagate role/injury uncertainty.
strategies.missing: Official player-game outcomes, pregame role data, prop line, price, timestamp, and settlement rules.

strategies.name: QB + receiver prop combination
strategies.hypothesis: Research proposal: joint opportunity/production model with coherent QB and receiver constraints.
strategies.missing: Matched player prop thresholds and outcomes; era robustness; official combo price; no correlation borrowed from team aggregates.
